summary: The SiteRecruitmentResources document provides the implementation details and structure for managing site recruitment resources within a web application. It includes various controls, data binding logic, and user interaction handling mechanisms.
purpose: To manage and update recruitment resources for a site within a web application.

workflows.name: Recruitment Resource Update
steps: Retrieve recruitment reference number and closed status from form.
Update recruitment resources with session, ID, webpage, reference number, and status.
Cache the user session and redirect to the maintenance profile page.

workflows.name: Data Selection
steps: Check if UserSession is null; if so, cancel the operation.
If UserSession is valid, set input parameters for session and SiteID.

workflows.name: Edit Command
steps: Change the mode of uxDetail to edit.
Set the header text for uxDetail.
Set the default value for site ID and show details in a modal popup.

validations: User session must be valid to proceed with data selection.
